configuration-actions.thisDeletesItsSave: This deletes its saved configuration. Retained sessions and history remain. The server rejects references that must be reconfigured first.
configuration-actions.schedulesUsingThis: Schedules using this configuration will be disabled for future runs. Already accepted sessions are retained.
configuration-actions.disconnectTheEntry: Disconnect the entry and finish credential cleanup before deleting it.
configuration-actions.disconnectTheAccou: Disconnect the account and finish credential cleanup before deleting it.
configuration-actions.browserProfileClea: Browser profile cleanup remains pending on each registered device until its native browser has shut down and the complete profile has been removed, including devices which are offline.
configuration-actions.thisPreviewIsReadO: This preview is read-only and does not consume routing turns or reserve an account. Execution rechecks current eligibility.
configuration-actions.insufficientCompar: Insufficient comparable quota evidence; the server used the configured policy's fallback.
